title: promotions.codes.revoke (proposal, ask P-RF1)
description: Proposed comm Function for stapel-promotions: revoke an issued, unredeemed code (for a reversed referral reward). Idempotent on idempotency_key. Returns {revoked: bool, redeemed: bool} (a redeemed code cannot be taken back; the caller records the reversal anyway). Set STAPEL_REFERRALS['PROMO_REVOKE_FUNCTION'] = 'promotions.codes.revoke' once it ships.
